finding.title: Archive entry path traversal in ArchivePaths.destination
finding.description: An archive entry name containing '../' yields a destination outside the extraction directory instead of being rejected.

plan.hypothesis: If the input described for the exploit probe (entry name '../../etc/cron.d/job' under destination 'out') reaches ArchivePaths.destination without confinement or encoding, then: Returns a destination path that resolves outside 'out' instead of rejecting the entry (an unaffected implementation raises its specific rejection, which means the condition did not occur)

control.seam: Call the real ArchivePaths.destination through its public interface
control.property_to_assert: Returns the entry path joined under the destination: 'out/docs/a.txt'

exploit.seam: Call the real ArchivePaths.destination through its public interface
exploit.property_to_assert: Returns a destination path that resolves outside 'out' instead of rejecting the entry (an unaffected implementation raises its specific rejection, which means the condition did not occur)

control.source:
require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'archive_paths'

class ArchivePathsControlTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'start'), '')
    holds = ArchivePaths.destination('out', 'docs/a.txt') == File.join('out', 'docs/a.txt')
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'check'), holds ? 'holds' : 'violated')
    assert holds, ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_TOKEN')
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'end'), '')
  end
end

exploit.source:
require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'archive_paths'

class ArchivePathsExploitTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_security_entry_escapes_destination
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'start'), '')
    dest = begin
      ArchivePaths.destination('out', '../../etc/cron.d/job')
    rescue ArgumentError
      nil
    end
    holds = !dest.nil? && !File.expand_path(dest).start_with?(File.expand_path('out') + File::SEPARATOR)
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'check'), holds ? 'holds' : 'violated')
    assert holds, ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_TOKEN')
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'end'), '')
  end
end

source_files.content:
# Where each entry of an uploaded archive is extracted.
module ArchivePaths
  def self.destination(dest, entry_name)
    File.join(dest, entry_name)
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'archive_paths'

class ArchivePathsTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_joins_entry
    assert_equal 'out/a.txt', ArchivePaths.destination('out', 'a.txt')
  end
end
